description: One signal routed out to one of eight jacks, or eight signals routed into one, chosen by a knob, a voltage or a clock; with nothing patched to either side it puts out a gate on the chosen row

params.text: Chooses which of the eight rows is switched through; with a clock patched it sets how many rows the stepping runs through before returning to the first

inputs.text: Multiplies the selector knob by a tenth of this voltage, so 10V gives the knob's own row and a patched cable at 0V forces the first row
Advances the selector one row on each rising edge above 1V, wrapping at the row the selector knob is set to; in gate mode the chosen output follows this signal high and low rather than staying high
Sends the stepping back to the first row on a rising edge above 1V; it is read only while a clock is patched
The single signal sent out to whichever row is chosen, the other seven outputs held at 0V
The signal for that row; when that row is the chosen one it reaches the single output at the far end and that row's own output as well

outputs.text: 0V unless this is the chosen row, and then whatever came into the module, or a 10V gate when nothing is patched into it at all
The chosen row's input, or with nothing patched into the module a staircase reading the row number, 0V for the first row and 10V for the eighth

notes: with all eight row inputs empty and the single input empty too, the module becomes a gate source: the chosen output goes to 10V and the rest to 0V, and a clock steps that gate along the rows
the OP button steps through four modes on each click: outputs as they are, outputs inverted, every row but the chosen one passed inverted, every row but the chosen one passed
the OP button and the yellow lamp that marks the chosen row are both drawn by the module rather than placed as widgets, so neither can be clicked for help

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.

high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
